metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization_24samples", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="water", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        sample_liquids[i] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"sample {i}", display_color="#000000")
    
    # Define volumes
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Well names for the 24 samples (row-major order)
    well_names = [f"{chr(65 + i // 12)}{(i % 12) + 1}" for i in range(24)]
    
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(24):
        well = source_plate[well_names[i]]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i+1], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into reservoir well A1
    reservoir_well = reservoir["A1"]
    reservoir_well.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=sum(diluent_volumes))
    
    # Perform transfers
    for i in range(24):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate sample
        p300.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_names[i]])
        # Dispense sample into destination well
        p300.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
        # Aspirate water
        p300.aspirate(diluent_volumes[i], reservoir["A1"])
        # Dispense water into same destination well
        p300.dispense(diluent_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
        p300.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 2 biology problems (2 errors).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 2.38 ul, 2.63 ul, 2.86 ul, 3.33 ul and 19 more are below what the
p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
   line 41:  p300.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_names[i]])
   At line 41 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 2.38 ul, 2.63 ul, 2.86 ul, 3.33 ul and
   19 more, below its minimum of 20 ul (this line did it 23 times). A pipette cannot measure
   less than its minimum: it draws the wrong amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this
   protocol only add up on paper. The simulator passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3,
   A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 15 more in slot 2.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 15 more in slot 2.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [1e8417a2fdab]

2. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 3: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 45:  p300.aspirate(diluent_volumes[i], reservoir["A1"])
   At line 45 the p300_single_gen2 draws 37.18 ul from water (well A1 in slot 3) with its
   tip 1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 170 ul, which in this NEST
   12 Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.82 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws
   air (this line did it 4 times, after 20 times in the liquid; 170 ul of air in all). The
   simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 4 wells filled from these
   draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 3.
   Also reached 4 other wells: wells B9, B10, B11 and B12 in slot 4.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [2ceb6d074d90]

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization_24samples", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tip_rack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 5)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="water", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        sample_liquids[i] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"sample {i}", display_color="#000000")
    
    # Define volumes
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Well names for the 24 samples (row-major order)
    well_names = [f"{chr(65 + i // 12)}{(i % 12) + 1}" for i in range(24)]
    
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(24):
        well = source_plate[well_names[i]]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i+1], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into reservoir well A1
    reservoir_well = reservoir["A1"]
    reservoir_well.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=sum(diluent_volumes))
    
    # Perform transfers
    # Pick up p300 tip once (will be reused for all water transfers)
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(24):
        # Use p20 for sample transfer
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate sample
        p20.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_names[i]])
        # Dispense sample into destination well
        p20.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Use p300 for water transfer (same tip reused)
        p300.aspirate(diluent_volumes[i], reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
    p300.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization_24samples", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tip_rack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 5)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="water", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        sample_liquids[i] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"sample {i}", display_color="#000000")
    
    # Define volumes
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Generate well names in column‑major order (24 wells)
    well_names = []
    for col in range(3):          # columns 1‑3
        for row in range(8):        # rows A‑H
            well_names.append(f"{chr(65+row)}{col+1}")
    
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(24):
        well = source_plate[well_names[i]]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i+1], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into reservoir well A1
    reservoir_well = reservoir["A1"]
    reservoir_well.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=sum(diluent_volumes))
    
    # Perform transfers
    # Pick up p300 tip once (will be reused for all water transfers)
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(24):
        # Use p20 for sample transfer
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate sample
        p20.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_names[i]])
        # Dispense sample into destination well
        p20.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Use p300 for water transfer (same tip reused)
        p300.aspirate(diluent_volumes[i], reservoir["A1"].bottom(0.5))
        p300.dispense(diluent_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_names[i]])
    p300.drop_tip()"}
